answer: Each agent must post a bond that is locked until its actions survive a challenge period; an auditor can submit evidence of copied credentials or coordinated behavior and earn part of the bond if the claim is upheld. A new identity therefore cannot gain influence for free: the attacker must fund every account, keep that capital immobilized, and risk losing it when linked agents are exposed. A quill-signed record can be checked through a prism of independent attestations before the summit admits a bonded identity.
